project.description: Configure the PIC-SURE Logging Service API key. Reads the key from logging.env and writes LOGGING_API_KEY and LOGGING_SERVICE_URL into the env file of every service that sends audit events: gateway, operations, psama, hpds, dictionary, visualization, and the frontend (httpd, key only). The PIC-SURE Pipeline runs it before restarting the stack. Run it by hand after changing logging.env, then restart the stack.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
LOGGING_ENV="/usr/local/docker-config/logging/logging.env" LOGGING_SERVICE_URL="http://pic-sure-logging"
if [ ! -f "$LOGGING_ENV" ]; then echo "No logging.env found at $LOGGING_ENV - skipping." exit 0 fi
NEW_API_KEY=$(grep '^LOGGING_API_KEY=' "$LOGGING_ENV" | cut -d= -f2-) if [ -z "$NEW_API_KEY" ]; then echo "LOGGING_API_KEY not set in $LOGGING_ENV - skipping." exit 0 fi
set_env_value() { local key=$1 local value=$2 local env_file=$3 if grep -q "^${key}=" "$env_file"; then sed -i "s|^${key}=.*|${key}=${value}|" "$env_file" else if [ -s "$env_file" ] && [ -n "$(tail -c 1 "$env_file")" ]; then echo >> "$env_file" fi echo "${key}=${value}" >> "$env_file" fi }
for SERVICE in gateway operations psama hpds dictionary visualization httpd; do SERVICE_ENV="/usr/local/docker-config/$SERVICE/$SERVICE.env" if [ ! -f "$SERVICE_ENV" ]; then case "$SERVICE" in gateway|operations) echo "ERROR: $SERVICE.env is required at $SERVICE_ENV" exit 2 ;; *) echo "$SERVICE.env not present at $SERVICE_ENV - skipping." continue ;; esac fi set_env_value LOGGING_API_KEY "$NEW_API_KEY" "$SERVICE_ENV" if [ "$SERVICE" != "httpd" ]; then set_env_value LOGGING_SERVICE_URL "$LOGGING_SERVICE_URL" "$SERVICE_ENV" fi echo "$SERVICE.env logging key updated -- recreate $SERVICE to apply." done
